# SFML dependency

Copied unmodified from the local Reference/Study/SFML-3.1.0 Windows binary package.
Included: headers, Graphics/Window/System dynamic import libraries and DLLs for Debug/Release, original license.
Excluded: examples, generated documentation, audio/network modules and static libraries.
SFML is authored by Laurent Gomila and contributors; see SFML-3.1.0/license.md.
Requires Windows x64, compatible MSVC runtime; C++17 or newer. The application sources in src/ are study scaffolding, not upstream SFML examples.
